name: tree-sitter

readme_excerpt: tree-sitter [![discord][discord]](https://discord.gg/w7nTvsVJhm) [![matrix][matrix]](https://matrix.to/#/#tree-sitter-chat:matrix.org) Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library. It can build a concrete syntax tree for a source file and efficiently update the syntax tree as the source file is edited.
